title: Heat Pump & AC costs have SKYROCKETED 🚀 What you can do
summary: An HVAC contractor explains why replacement prices rose after 2020 and advises getting several bids, replacing before failure in the off season, and bundling.

assertions.quote: haven't gotten a bid on what it costs to replace an HVAC system in a few years you might be in for a surprise

verdicts.note: Producer price indexes and refrigerant transitions drove double-digit HVAC equipment and install price increases since 2020.

assertions.quote: if you see one bid that is substantially cheaper than the other two I would be very wary of that bid
by being proactive and replacing things in the off season oftentimes contractors will wheel and deal and give promotional shoulder season discounts

verdicts.note: Planned replacement allows comparing bids and seasonal promotions, but discounts are anecdotal and vary.

assertions.quote: a lot of companies will provide bundle deals if you're replacing both the furnace and air conditioner at the same time

verdicts.note: Bundle pricing is a contractor practice with no independent data on its size.
